headline.title: Ask an AI expert: What exactly is the full stack?
headline.summary: The article explores the concept of full-stack AI infrastructure, detailing its components and how they integrate to create comprehensive AI solutions. It provides insights from an AI expert on the various layers involved, from data management to model deployment.

articles.title: AI agents are not your “coworkers”
articles.summary: The article discusses the misconception that AI agents can be considered "coworkers," emphasizing that they are tools designed to assist rather than colleagues. It highlights the implications of integrating AI into the workplace and the need for clear distinctions between human workers and AI systems.

articles.title: South Korean tech giants commit over $550B to ease ‘RAMageddon’
articles.summary: South Korea's leading memory chip manufacturers have pledged over $550 billion to expand memory fabrication facilities in response to increasing demand for AI technologies. This investment aims to strengthen the country's position as a global AI tech powerhouse.

articles.title: Arena, the AI leaderboard everyone uses, is now a $100M business
articles.summary: Arena, a startup known for its widely used AI leaderboard, has reached a valuation of $100 million following the launch of its commercial service in September 2022. The platform provides a competitive environment for AI developers to showcase their models and track performance.

articles.title: Tidal won’t pay royalties on AI-generated music but isn’t banning it outright
articles.summary: Tidal announced that it will not pay royalties on AI-generated music, effective immediately, while labeling tracks identified as fully AI-generated with an icon starting July 15th. The platform aims to protect artists and inform listeners without outright banning AI-generated content.

articles.title: Gemini’s personalized AI image generation is now free for US users
articles.summary: Google has made Gemini's personalized AI image generation feature available for free to eligible users in the U.S., enabling the chatbot to create images tailored to individual interests and data from connected Google applications. This expansion aims to enhance user experience by leveraging personal data for customized image creation.

articles.title: OpenAI is teasing new hardware… for Codex
articles.summary: OpenAI is set to unveil new hardware related to its AI coding tool, Codex, on July 15th, featuring a square-shaped device with multiple buttons. The announcement was made via a video on X, indicating an upgrade to Codex shortcuts.

articles.title: Anthropic and Gov. Newsom forge deal allowing California government to use Claude at half price
articles.summary: Anthropic has reached an agreement with California Governor Gavin Newsom to provide the state's government access to its AI model, Claude, at a 50% discount. This partnership comes amid increasing tensions between Anthropic and the federal government, positioning the company as a competitor to OpenAI.

articles.title: Robot hand company settles Tesla trade secret suit and announces $11M raise
articles.summary: Proception, a startup focused on developing robotic hands, has settled a trade secret lawsuit with Tesla and announced an $11 million funding round. The company aims to innovate in the field of robotics by employing a unique method for gathering training data.

articles.title: DiScoFormer: One transformer for density and score, across distributions
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced DiScoFormer, a novel transformer model designed to simultaneously estimate density and score functions across various distributions. This approach aims to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of generative modeling tasks in machine learning.

articles.title: Claude Meets Blackwell Ultra: Anthropic’s Models Now Run on NVIDIA GB300 in Azure
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude models are now available on Microsoft Azure, utilizing NVIDIA's GB300 Blackwell Ultra GPUs. This integration allows enterprises to develop autonomous and domain-specific AI agents more effectively.

articles.title: Mapping Europe’s AI Workforce Opportunity
articles.summary: A recent OpenAI report analyzes the potential impact of AI on the European workforce, identifying occupations at risk of automation as well as those expected to grow or undergo workflow changes. The findings aim to provide insights into how AI could reshape job opportunities across the EU.
